question: What did Barak say to Deborah when she gave him the LORD's command?
options: I will go only if God gives me a sign
I will go if the elders agree
I will go if you give me a thousand chariots
If you go with me, I will go; but if you don't go with me, I won't go
explanation: Barak told Deborah he would go only if she went with him.
